claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_triggered_item_hazard
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an always-on, non-optional, non-resource-consuming trigger that damages only certain creatures when they touch, hold, or carry the item. Current magic-item mechanics support passive grants, activations, triggered reactions, and composites of those, but not a passive triggered hazard.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke deterministically destroys the target on a failed save. No existing effect atom models immediate destruction/removal from play while leaving no remains.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric.attack_filter = spell_attack_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive bonus applies to spell attack rolls only, not all attack rolls and not weapon-filtered rolls. Current modify_roll_numeric can narrow by weapon only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.target_save_modifier_by_creature_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke conditionally gives the target disadvantage on the saving throw only if the target is a Fiend or Undead. Current save_gate has no target-type-conditional save modifier hook.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: target_selection.ground_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke can target only a creature on the ground. Current target selection has type filters but no spatial state predicate like grounded/on-ground.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself
